body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Sharp presented ''RD-CX100'', an electronic dictionary that supports a variety of content including Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese and etc. It offers ''RealSpeak'' function and other features include mp3p, voice recorder, and e-book(text viewer). The company will release this model in December.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
